title: Design a real-time notification system.
description: Use WebSockets or Server-Sent Events, message queues, and push notification services.

data.text: Use WebSockets or SSE for real-time delivery, a message queue to fan out notifications, and a push notification service for mobile offline users.

items: Connection gateway: WebSocket or SSE with sticky sessions
Notification service: formats and enqueues messages
Fan-out service: distributes to active connections
Persistent store: notification history for catch-up
Push bridge: APNs/FCM for mobile devices
How do you handle 1 million concurrent connections?
How do you prevent notification spam?
